name: Four-wing saltbush
desc: Four-wing saltbush (Atriplex canescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Atriplex canescens (or chamiso, chamiza, four-wing saltbush) is a species of evergreen shrub in the family Amaranthaceae (subfamily Chenopodioideae) native to the western and midwestern United States.
